verdict.rationale: Context-Aware Access docs describe granular per-app access policies based on user identity, location, device security status, and IP address. That covers the network, device, and location signals in the story. Community reports confirm the device-verification enforcement works in practice, but note painful troubleshooting because the denial page doesn't say which policy blocked access, and full device signals depend on Chrome Endpoint Verification. Missing for 10: evidence of risk-score signals feeding policies, explicit documentation of scoping CAA policies per group, and policy-debugging visibility.
